mechanism: Branded frozen-food demand, price/mix, restructuring and working-capital discipline can stabilize Nomad Foods margins and free cash flow and preserve shareholder distributions if volume recovers and leverage declines.
catalyst: Volume stabilizes, restructuring produces the stated margin inflection, free-cash-flow conversion improves, leverage declines and the dividend remains covered after brand and capacity investment.
invalidation: Volume contraction persists; brand pricing loses elasticity; restructuring fails to improve margins; working capital or cash conversion weakens; leverage rises; or debt service and distributions absorb operating value.
